reviews.text: Virginia is simply wonderful! Our dog Gucci has been coming here forever, and the love she has for her groomer says it all. Besides always leaving her looking impeccable and beautiful, Virginia demonstrates incredible dedication and a genuine love for all her furry friends. For me, she's by far the best choice.
I was worried about some knots and they removed them without any problem, you can tell they know what they're doing.
Excellent service

I took my two dogs there and I have to say I couldn't be happier. The service was excellent; the environment was very relaxed for them; the place was spotless; Vir is a fantastic professional. I highly recommend it ❤️

Absolutely fantastic! Rocío has been treating my dog ​​his whole life, first at another clinic and now at hers, and we couldn't be happier. Excellent service, professionalism from all the staff; I feel my dog ​​is in good hands there.
Excellent service. Very friendly and highly recommended.
Thank you so much, Heydi, for trusting us. Hugs, and we'll always be here whenever you need our services.
It's a trustworthy pet groomer. Virginia is incredibly friendly, treats animals well, and answers any questions you might have about your furry friend's coat. I would definitely go back.
Excellent service, impeccable attention. The experience was very calm and peaceful, a great surprise for me since my dog ​​is very skittish. I recommend it 100%.

Virginia is undoubtedly one of the best dog groomers in the neighborhood, in the south of the city, and I'd even venture to say in the entire region. She's attentive, kind, and meticulous in her work. I've been taking my little one there for years, and I have nothing but words of gratitude for her dedication.
They always make them look gorgeous and they come back super happy, I'm very happy with the service and the result

After many bad experiences with various groomers, I found Virginia and I couldn't be more grateful. Other places only offered to sedate my dog ​​for her haircut because she was so scared. Virginia has managed to make Maya feel calm and happy going in! She treats her with so much love and care, respecting her pace and with so much patience, which is so important to me. I won't change groomers; besides the excellent service, when she comes out of the salon she looks like a teddy bear!
Virginia was so attentive from the moment I arrived for my dog ​​Bella's appointment! She made her look so beautiful and I really loved it, I've found my go-to groomer! ♥️
I'm so grateful to Virginia for the wonderful work she does and the way she always treats Nala. She's my trusted hairdresser; I leave happier every time, and so does Nala 😍 …
Thank you to Virginia because she always makes my little Hada look absolutely gorgeous. She is undoubtedly a true professional.

For me, she's the best dog groomer there is. I have a very timid Maltese who had been through a lot of trauma and had a chronic illness; he used to be terrified of going everywhere. Now he's happy at the groomer's, and we're happy. We'll go wherever Vir goes.
We took our puppy (a Westie) for the first time and he looked beautiful, we're so happy!! Thank you Virginia!
My Thor goes to the groomer so happy! It took me a while to finally find a groomer where my dog ​​is happy and comes out looking exactly how I like... Very pleased with the work
Very, very good! My dog ​​is a Botail, which is super difficult to wash and brush, and this leaves him looking spectacular. Thank you so much!

From the first time we took Milo there at four months old, it was love at first sight between him and Vir. And we were delighted to witness it and to continue nurturing it with each visit. I recommend their work to everyone I know, and now through this review.
